Use case: identity-preserve. New GDD enemy BODY animation: Hung Linh Hứa Lập Quốc, exact south: strict FRONT toward screen DOWN, two eyes/chest in every pose.
Image1 OWN inspected SAME-VIEW neutral is PRIMARY camera, nonhuman anatomy and identity. Image2 Wang supports camera/pixel only. Only requested SAME-VIEW images are provided: inherit approved identity through the own-view lineage, never borrow another camera.
Identity: OWN approved spectral villain with long tied dark hair and sly mature smirk, tattered charcoal/ivory spectral cloth, 96px intrinsic silhouette. Preserve soft RGBA hem. No physical boots, borrowed mentor short hair or attached sword.
Exactly FOUR COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS, SIXTEEN complete isolated figures on2048x1536. Each has spacious512x384 area; generous80px outer margins and80px clear gutters on ALL edges. Never enlarge a figure to fill a cell. ROWS1+2: eight identical own standing neutral calibration figures. ROWS3+4: eight ordered attack figures: floating ready / near shoulder coils backward / compact empty hand hooks inward at chest / short forward raking palm with small grouped fingers / torso and hair recoil / floating ready restored / same settled final posture / same settled final posture.
ONE scale for the complete source from the neutral calibration, nominal 96 native pixels. Keep own skull/armor dimensions throughout. Lean, compression, crouch and fall lower the pose naturally; never fit per-pose height. Keep actual camera and anatomical rear occlusion in all actions. Rear hands do not show through torso, mantle or hair.
Compact attached hands/fingers for human/spirit; complete heavy stone fists for construct. Both actual stone feet/boots stay attached where applicable; spectral character has NO boots or invented walking legs. No mirrored view or flipped costume. All figures isolated by generous transparent gutters, with ample margins for complete hair, fists and prone body on all edges.
Truly transparent RGBA, crisp stepped pixel contours and limited shade bands. Body/outfit only; no floor, shadow, captions, grid, held weapon, projectile, detached shards, duplicate actor, warning ring, spell glow, smoke, aura or external FX. Preserve original intrinsic soft spectral alpha, not binary clipping. Each key still has a complete visible body; no empty/fully vanished final slot.
FINAL CAMERA AUTHORITY for south: copy Image1 orientation into ALL 12 figures, including neutral calibration, recoil, wind-up and low poses. Show the exact front/diagonal head and torso from Image1, with correct face/chest, never the other diagonal. Preserve own hair/skull, material, attached limbs and body build exactly from Image1, including any own hair tuft/tie; descriptive hair shorthand never overrides the actual inspected identity. No mirror, fitting, external prop or FX.

SPACIOUS SOURCE: every calibration and action body complete and fully inside image; no hand can touch neighboring hair. Same source-wide scale and requested own camera in all16 figures. Rear N/NE/NW hide face/pupils; front-of-sternum command hands are naturally occluded by torso from rear, never clasp behind the back or show skin on the back belt. Release arm may clear shoulder silhouette. Keep attached wrists and grouped fingers. No mirror, fit, pixel painting or external FX.
Spectral anatomy: absolutely NO shoes/boots/walking legs in ANY calibration or action figure. Preserve own approved intrinsic soft-alpha ragged hem and96px build; move is floating glide and subdued is contracted complete spirit, never physical kneeling or corpse.

EXPLICIT ACTION CORRECTION AFTER SOURCE REVIEW: Exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS,16 figures: rows1+2 eight own neutral calibrations; row3 attack0 ready,1 shoulder coils,2 compact hand hook at chest,3 SHORT FORWARD RAKING PALM STRIKE toward South/front; row4 attack4 torso recoil,5 own neutral recovery,6 rest,7 rest. Clear body motion and connected wrists. No repeated neutral row standing in for attack. All figures at most60 percent cell height with15 percent top/bottom margins; no boots/legs or external FX.
